tools.name: email_meeting_invitation
tools.description: Sends an email meeting invitation with an attached .ics calendar file to the listed attendees. Delivers the message through the company SMTP server.

params.name: attendees
params.description: Email addresses of the people to invite

params.name: duration_minutes
params.description: Length of the meeting in minutes

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain_core.tools import tool

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", "")
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", "")


@tool
def email_meeting_invitation(
    attendees: list,
    title: str,
    start_iso: str,
    duration_minutes: int,
    location: str,
    organizer_email: str,
) -> str:
    start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_iso)
    end = start + timedelta(minutes=duration_minutes)
    fmt = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"
    uid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    stamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    ics_lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//SchedulerAgent//EN",
        "METHOD:REQUEST",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{stamp}",
        f"DTSTART:{start.strftime(fmt)}",
        f"DTEND:{end.strftime(fmt)}",
        f"SUMMARY:{title}",
        f"LOCATION:{location}",
        f"ORGANIZER:mailto:{organizer_email}",
    ]
    for address in attendees:
        ics_lines.append(f"ATTENDEE;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:{address}")
    ics_lines += ["END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"]
    ics_body = "\r\n".join(ics_lines)

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Invitation: {title}"
    msg["From"] = organizer_email
    msg["To"] = ", ".join(attendees)
    msg.set_content(
        f"You are invited to {title}\nWhen: {start.isoformat()} ({duration_minutes} min)\nWhere: {location}"
    )
    msg.add_attachment(
        ics_body.encode("utf-8"),
        maintype="text",
        subtype="calendar",
        filename="invite.ics",
        params={"method": "REQUEST"},
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        server.send_message(msg)

    return f"Invitation '{title}' sent to {len(attendees)} attendee(s) with event id {uid}"

tools.name: book_paid_consultation_slot
tools.description: Charges the client's saved card for a consultation and runs the booking job that reserves the chosen time slot on the calendar.

params.name: slot_id
params.description: Identifier of the calendar slot to reserve

tools.code:
import subprocess

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


def _run_booking_job(slot_id: str, payment_id: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/scheduler/bin/reserve_slot", "--slot", slot_id, "--payment", payment_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    return result.stdout.strip()


@function_tool
def book_paid_consultation_slot(customer_id: str, slot_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"slot_id": slot_id},
        idempotency_key=f"slot-{slot_id}-{customer_id}",
    )
    output = _run_booking_job(slot_id, intent.id)
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents ({intent.id}). Booking job: {output}"

tools.name: list_events_for_day
tools.description: Looks up all events on a given day in the local calendar database, ordered by start time.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

DB_PATH = "calendar.db"


def list_events_for_day(day: str) -> list:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, start_time, end_time, location FROM events "
        "WHERE date(start_time) = date(?) ORDER BY start_time",
        (day,),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return [dict(row) for row in rows]
